subject.title: refactor: consolidate messaging delivery and account regressions

question: Should this maintainer-requested stacked test refactor proceed with an explicit proof override for its test-only scope, or should it first include redacted real channel/account behavior evidence after the parent stack lands?
rationale: The protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling, and the external-PR proof policy does not treat unit tests and coverage alone as real behavior proof.

options.title: Review and allow a proof override
options.body: Confirm that the test-only scope and supplied focused regression/coverage evidence are sufficient for this stacked maintenance change.

options.title: Request live regression evidence
options.body: Ask for a redacted real Discord, Slack, or Matrix setup demonstration covering an affected delivery or account path after the stack is applied.

options.title: Split or rebase after parents land
options.body: Pause this increment until the two prerequisite PRs are resolved, then review its four-file incremental diff against the resulting base.

recommendation.title: Review and allow a proof override
recommendation.body: Confirm that the test-only scope and supplied focused regression/coverage evidence are sufficient for this stacked maintenance change.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies this person as the requester and author of the complete declared three-commit stack, though current-main ownership history was not available here.
